sample_counter_contract.target_only: GetPathTracingSampleCount returns LastConfig.PathTracingData.MaxSamples, not an observation
sample_counter_contract.acceptance_rule: accept only if sample index >= target before screenshot, after screenshot and after camera readback

applied_readbacks.material_camera_note: material detail camera is saved and read back from its actor; the viewport is deliberately left piloted on the hero camera

setup_path_tracer.sample_counter_authority: GetPathTracingSampleIndex is the accumulation index; GetPathTracingSampleCount is target-only (LastConfig MaxSamples) and is recorded but not used as observed spp
setup_path_tracer.sky_model: SkyAtmosphere_Sponza + SkyLight_Sponza real-time captured scene cubemap (intensity 16). PT integrates that same SkyLight cubemap; it does not use the separate volumetric reference-atmosphere path.
setup_path_tracer.probe_decision: PT probe at 32 spp, VisibleLights=2: EnableReferenceAtmosphere=0 kept the accumulation index at 32 before and after screenshot and produced a readable sky/sun frame. EnableReferenceAtmosphere=1 dropped the post-screenshot index to 3 and produced a dark, incorrect frame, so it is rejected for the final reference.
